cards.headline:
A $449 Linux phone built
around AI Bible study
cards.body: Christian project Jesus Dash blends Linux and AI, and its founder plans a $449 PineCone phone for early 2027.

blocks.x: Can faith and artificial intelligence come together in a new operating system? Jesus Dash is an ambitious Christian technology project combining Linux, AI-powered assistance, and religious resources.
Its founder is also developing a $449 smartphone called PineCone, targeting early 2027.
